# Layer 1 of the 3-layer cache: sccache wraps rustc and caches compiler
# artifacts in-memory. Hits are shared across every Rust project on this box.
# Sized for 32-core / 126 GB host; 12 GB headroom plus 16 parallel rustc
# jobs gives cache hits on the same crate for both feature and non-feature
# builds. Layer 2 (bazel-remote AC+CAS) and Layer 3 (Cargo `target/`) are
# configured elsewhere; sccache only governs rustc invocations.
[build]
rustc-wrapper = "/home/lewis/.local/share/mise/installs/sccache/0.16.0/sccache-v0.16.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/sccache"
jobs = 16

[env]
SCCACHE_DIR = "/home/lewis/.cache/sccache"
SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE = "12G"
SCCACHE_MAX_FRAME_LENGTH = "104857600"
SCCACHE_BASEDIR = "/home/lewis/src/velvet-ballistics"

[alias]
ci = "clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings"
check-all = "check --workspace --all-targets --all-features"
fmt-check = "fmt --all -- --check"
doc-all = "doc --workspace --all-features --no-deps"
test-all = "test --workspace --all-features"
hardened-build = "build --workspace --all-features --profile hardened"
nightly-feature-cargo-probe = "check -Zallow-features=try_blocks,portable_simd,allocator_api,generic_const_exprs --workspace --all-targets --all-features"
xtask = "run -p xtask --"

# Mechanical Invariants for velvet-ballistics
# Executable rules checked by `cargo xtask invariants`
# Source of truth for what "mechanically enforced" means

invariants:

  # ============================================================
  # RUNTIME CORE: NO YAML/JSON/HTTP
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_runtime_yaml
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - saphyr_parser
      - parse_workflow_source
      - yaml
      - YamlLoader
      - YamlParser
    description: "Runtime core must not contain YAML parsing or interpretation"

  - id: no_runtime_json
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - serde_json
      - json
      - JsonValue
      - JsonObject
    description: "Runtime core must not contain JSON handling"

  - id: no_runtime_http
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - http
      - hyper
      - reqwest
      - axum
      - actix
    description: "Runtime core must not contain HTTP servers or clients"

  # ============================================================
  # HOT PATH: NO ALLOCATION / FORMATTING
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_hot_path_formatting
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden_macros:
      - format
      - format!
      - println
      - eprintln
      - dbg
      - dbg!
    description: "Hot path must not contain formatting or debug output"

  - id: no_hot_path_allocation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - Vec::new\(\)
      - String::new\(\)
      - Box::new
      - vec!\[\]
    description: "Hot path must not dynamically allocate"
    exceptions:
      - frame_pool initialization (pre-allocated)
      - trace ring initialization (pre-allocated)

  # ============================================================
  # INDEX SAFETY: NO UNCHECKED ARITHMETIC
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unchecked_indexing
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - indexing
      - slicing
      - get_unchecked
      - slice::from_raw_parts
    description: "No unchecked indexing or slicing"

  - id: no_unchecked_arithmetic
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - offset
      - add
      - sub
      - mul
      - wrapping
      - overflowing
    description: "No unchecked arithmetic operations"
    exceptions:
      - checked arithmetic via TryFrom/TryInto
      - saturating arithmetic where explicitly documented

  - id: no_unchecked_casts
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - as_i32
      - as_u64
      - as_usize
      - as_f64
    description: "No unchecked as casts"
    exceptions:
      - checked casts via TryFrom/TryInto
      - checked casts via From/TryFrom traits

  # ============================================================
  # ERROR HANDLING: NO IGNORED RESULTS
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_ignored_result
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - ok\(\)
      - err\(\)
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(
    description: "No ignored Result or Option"

  - id: no_unwrap_in_hot_path
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(

  # ============================================================
  # STATE MACHINE: VALID TRANSITIONS ONLY
  # ============================================================
  - id: step_state_valid_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Valid StepState transitions:
      Pending → Running, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped
      Running → Succeeded, Failed, Waiting, Asking, Cancelled, Skipped
      Waiting → Running
      Asking → Running
      Succeeded/Failed/Cancelled/Skipped → themselves only

  - id: terminal_state_immutable
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Once a run reaches terminal state (Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped),
      it cannot transition back to Running or any non-terminal state

  # ============================================================
  # TAINT: LATTICE LAWS
  # ============================================================
  - id: taint_lattice_join_associative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(join_taint(a, b), c) == join_taint(a, join_taint(b, c))"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_commutative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, b) == join_taint(b, a)"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_idempotent
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, a) == a"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_identity
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, Clean) == a"

  - id: secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, Secret) == Secret"

  - id: derived_from_secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, DerivedFromSecret) == DerivedFromSecret"

  # ============================================================
  # BUDGET: NEVER NEGATIVE / UNDERFLOW
  # ============================================================
  - id: budget_try_take_never_underflows
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::try_take() returns false when budget is 0, never underflows"

  - id: budget_remaining_non_negative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::remaining is always >= 0"

  - id: budget_zero_executes_zero_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "Budget 0 causes immediate StepBudgetExhausted"

  # ============================================================
  # HANDLE VALIDITY
  # ============================================================
  - id: handle_validity_checked
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: |
      All handle accesses (SymbolId, ListId, ObjectId, BlobId) go through
      validity checks. Handle is valid iff id.as_usize() < arena.len()

  # ============================================================
  # RESOURCE BOUNDS
  # ============================================================
  - id: slot_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame slot count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: step_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame step count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: expression_stack_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/stack.rs
    description: "Expression stack depth is bounded to MAX_EXPR_STACK (64)"

  - id: expression_ops_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/bytecode.rs
    description: "Expression op count is bounded to MAX_EXPR_OPS (256)"

  # ============================================================
  # IPC: REJECT BEFORE ALLOCATION
  # ============================================================
  - id: ipc_reject_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      IPC decoder validates magic, header_len, and payload_len <= max
      BEFORE allocating payload bytes

  - id: ipc_no_payload_alloc_on_error
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: "Failed header validation must not allocate payload buffer"

  # ============================================================
  # STORAGE: RECORD DECODE ORDER
  # ============================================================
  - id: record_magic_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates magic before payload allocation"

  - id: record_crc_before_trust
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates CRC before trusting Postcard decode"

  # ============================================================
  # JOURNAL: BEFORE-DISPATCH
  # ============================================================
  - id: journal_before_dispatch
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/journal.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionScheduled journal event committed before action dispatched"

  - id: action_completion_before_frame_mutation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionCompleted journal event committed before frame mutated"

  # ============================================================
  # NO UNSAFE IN FIRST PARTY
  # ============================================================
…
# ============================================================
…
    - cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D unsafe_code

# Mechanical Invariants for velvet-ballistics
# Executable rules checked by `cargo xtask invariants`
# Source of truth for what "mechanically enforced" means

invariants:

  # ============================================================
  # RUNTIME CORE: NO YAML/JSON/HTTP
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_runtime_yaml
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - saphyr_parser
      - parse_workflow_source
      - yaml
      - YamlLoader
      - YamlParser
    description: "Runtime core must not contain YAML parsing or interpretation"

  - id: no_runtime_json
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - serde_json
      - json
      - JsonValue
      - JsonObject
    description: "Runtime core must not contain JSON handling"

  - id: no_runtime_http
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - http
      - hyper
      - reqwest
      - axum
      - actix
    description: "Runtime core must not contain HTTP servers or clients"

  # ============================================================
  # HOT PATH: NO ALLOCATION / FORMATTING
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_hot_path_formatting
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden_macros:
      - format
      - format!
      - println
      - eprintln
      - dbg
      - dbg!
    description: "Hot path must not contain formatting or debug output"

  - id: no_hot_path_allocation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - Vec::new\(\)
      - String::new\(\)
      - Box::new
      - vec!\[\]
    description: "Hot path must not dynamically allocate"
    exceptions:
      - frame_pool initialization (pre-allocated)
      - trace ring initialization (pre-allocated)

  # ============================================================
  # INDEX SAFETY: NO UNCHECKED ARITHMETIC
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unchecked_indexing
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - indexing
      - slicing
      - get_unchecked
      - slice::from_raw_parts
    description: "No unchecked indexing or slicing"

  - id: no_unchecked_arithmetic
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - offset
      - add
      - sub
      - mul
      - wrapping
      - overflowing
    description: "No unchecked arithmetic operations"
    exceptions:
      - checked arithmetic via TryFrom/TryInto
      - saturating arithmetic where explicitly documented

  - id: no_unchecked_casts
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - as_i32
      - as_u64
      - as_usize
      - as_f64
    description: "No unchecked as casts"
    exceptions:
      - checked casts via TryFrom/TryInto
      - checked casts via From/TryFrom traits

  # ============================================================
  # ERROR HANDLING: NO IGNORED RESULTS
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_ignored_result
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - ok\(\)
      - err\(\)
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(
    description: "No ignored Result or Option"

  - id: no_unwrap_in_hot_path
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(

  # ============================================================
  # STATE MACHINE: VALID TRANSITIONS ONLY
  # ============================================================
  - id: step_state_valid_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Valid StepState transitions:
      Pending → Running, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped
      Running → Succeeded, Failed, Waiting, Asking, Cancelled, Skipped
      Waiting → Running
      Asking → Running
      Succeeded/Failed/Cancelled/Skipped → themselves only

  - id: terminal_state_immutable
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Once a run reaches terminal state (Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped),
      it cannot transition back to Running or any non-terminal state

  # ============================================================
  # TAINT: LATTICE LAWS
  # ============================================================
  - id: taint_lattice_join_associative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(join_taint(a, b), c) == join_taint(a, join_taint(b, c))"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_commutative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, b) == join_taint(b, a)"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_idempotent
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, a) == a"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_identity
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, Clean) == a"

  - id: secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, Secret) == Secret"

  - id: derived_from_secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, DerivedFromSecret) == DerivedFromSecret"

  # ============================================================
  # BUDGET: NEVER NEGATIVE / UNDERFLOW
  # ============================================================
  - id: budget_try_take_never_underflows
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::try_take() returns false when budget is 0, never underflows"

  - id: budget_remaining_non_negative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::remaining is always >= 0"

  - id: budget_zero_executes_zero_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "Budget 0 causes immediate StepBudgetExhausted"

  # ============================================================
  # HANDLE VALIDITY
  # ============================================================
  - id: handle_validity_checked
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: |
      All handle accesses (SymbolId, ListId, ObjectId, BlobId) go through
      validity checks. Handle is valid iff id.as_usize() < arena.len()

  # ============================================================
  # RESOURCE BOUNDS
  # ============================================================
  - id: slot_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame slot count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: step_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame step count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: expression_stack_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/stack.rs
    description: "Expression stack depth is bounded to MAX_EXPR_STACK (64)"

  - id: expression_ops_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/bytecode.rs
    description: "Expression op count is bounded to MAX_EXPR_OPS (256)"

  # ============================================================
  # IPC: REJECT BEFORE ALLOCATION
  # ============================================================
  - id: ipc_reject_before_alloc
    applies_to:

# Mechanical Invariants for velvet-ballistics
# Executable rules checked by `cargo xtask invariants`
# Source of truth for what "mechanically enforced" means

invariants:

  # ============================================================
  # RUNTIME CORE: NO YAML/JSON/HTTP
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_runtime_yaml
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - saphyr_parser
      - parse_workflow_source
      - yaml
      - YamlLoader
      - YamlParser
    description: "Runtime core must not contain YAML parsing or interpretation"

  - id: no_runtime_json
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - serde_json
      - json
      - JsonValue
      - JsonObject
    description: "Runtime core must not contain JSON handling"

  - id: no_runtime_http
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - http
      - hyper
      - reqwest
      - axum
      - actix
    description: "Runtime core must not contain HTTP servers or clients"

  # ============================================================
  # HOT PATH: NO ALLOCATION / FORMATTING
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_hot_path_formatting
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden_macros:
      - format
      - format!
      - println
      - eprintln
      - dbg
      - dbg!
    description: "Hot path must not contain formatting or debug output"

  - id: no_hot_path_allocation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - Vec::new\(\)
      - String::new\(\)
      - Box::new
      - vec!\[\]
    description: "Hot path must not dynamically allocate"
    exceptions:
      - frame_pool initialization (pre-allocated)
      - trace ring initialization (pre-allocated)

  # ============================================================
  # INDEX SAFETY: NO UNCHECKED ARITHMETIC
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unchecked_indexing
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - indexing
      - slicing
      - get_unchecked
      - slice::from_raw_parts
    description: "No unchecked indexing or slicing"

  - id: no_unchecked_arithmetic
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - offset
      - add
      - sub
      - mul
      - wrapping
      - overflowing
    description: "No unchecked arithmetic operations"
    exceptions:
      - checked arithmetic via TryFrom/TryInto
      - saturating arithmetic where explicitly documented

  - id: no_unchecked_casts
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - as_i32
      - as_u64
      - as_usize
      - as_f64
    description: "No unchecked as casts"
    exceptions:
      - checked casts via TryFrom/TryInto
      - checked casts via From/TryFrom traits

  # ============================================================
  # ERROR HANDLING: NO IGNORED RESULTS
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_ignored_result
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - ok\(\)
      - err\(\)
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(
    description: "No ignored Result or Option"

  - id: no_unwrap_in_hot_path
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(

  # ============================================================
  # STATE MACHINE: VALID TRANSITIONS ONLY
  # ============================================================
  - id: step_state_valid_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Valid StepState transitions:
      Pending → Running, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped
      Running → Succeeded, Failed, Waiting, Asking, Cancelled, Skipped
      Waiting → Running
      Asking → Running
      Succeeded/Failed/Cancelled/Skipped → themselves only

  - id: terminal_state_immutable
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Once a run reaches terminal state (Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped),
      it cannot transition back to Running or any non-terminal state

  # ============================================================
  # TAINT: LATTICE LAWS
  # ============================================================
  - id: taint_lattice_join_associative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(join_taint(a, b), c) == join_taint(a, join_taint(b, c))"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_commutative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, b) == join_taint(b, a)"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_idempotent
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, a) == a"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_identity
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, Clean) == a"

  - id: secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, Secret) == Secret"

  - id: derived_from_secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, DerivedFromSecret) == DerivedFromSecret"

  # ============================================================
  # BUDGET: NEVER NEGATIVE / UNDERFLOW
  # ============================================================
  - id: budget_try_take_never_underflows
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::try_take() returns false when budget is 0, never underflows"

  - id: budget_remaining_non_negative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::remaining is always >= 0"

  - id: budget_zero_executes_zero_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "Budget 0 causes immediate StepBudgetExhausted"

  # ============================================================
  # HANDLE VALIDITY
  # ============================================================
  - id: handle_validity_checked
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: |
      All handle accesses (SymbolId, ListId, ObjectId, BlobId) go through
      validity checks. Handle is valid iff id.as_usize() < arena.len()

  # ============================================================
  # RESOURCE BOUNDS
  # ============================================================
  - id: slot_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame slot count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: step_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame step count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: expression_stack_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/stack.rs
    description: "Expression stack depth is bounded to MAX_EXPR_STACK (64)"

  - id: expression_ops_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/bytecode.rs
    description: "Expression op count is bounded to MAX_EXPR_OPS (256)"

  # ============================================================
  # IPC: REJECT BEFORE ALLOCATION
  # ============================================================
  - id: ipc_reject_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      IPC decoder validates magic, header_len, and payload_len <= max
      BEFORE allocating payload bytes

  - id: ipc_no_payload_alloc_on_error
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: "Failed header validation must not allocate payload buffer"

  # ============================================================
  # STORAGE: RECORD DECODE ORDER
  # ============================================================
  - id: record_magic_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates magic before payload allocation"

  - id: record_crc_before_trust
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates CRC before trusting Postcard decode"

  # ============================================================
  # JOURNAL: BEFORE-DISPATCH
  # ============================================================
  - id: journal_before_dispatch
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/journal.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionScheduled journal event committed before action dispatched"

  - id: action_completion_before_frame_mutation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionCompleted journal event committed before frame mutated"

  # ============================================================
  # NO UNSAFE IN FIRST PARTY
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unsafe_in_first_party
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_expr/**
      - crates/vb_validate/**
      - crates/vb_compile/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
    description: "First-party crates must have #![forbid(unsafe_code)]"

  # ============================================================
  # NO PANIC IN FIRST PARTY
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_panic_in_first_party
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_expr/**
      - crates/vb_validate/**
      - crates/vb_compile/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
    forbidden:
      - panic!
      - todo!
      - unimplemented!
    description: "First-party code must not panic"
    exceptions:
      - OOM (std::alloc::AllocError) where explicitly noted
      - Catastrophic allocator failure (explicitly documented)

  # ============================================================
  # IDEMPOTENCY
  # ============================================================
  - id: idempotency_key_well_formed
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/idempotency.rs
    description: "Idempotency keys are unique per (run, step, action, attempt)"

  - id: no_duplicate_non_idempotent_effect
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/idempotency.rs
    description: "Non-idempotent actions are not re-executed during replay"

  # ============================================================
  # ============================================================
  # COMPILE DIGEST COMPLETENESS
  # ============================================================
  - id: digest_primitive_coverage
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_compile/src/mod_compile_lowering/part_05.rs
    description: "digest_step_primitive must consume all semantic fields of each StepPrimitive variant (not just the variant name). Currently fixed for Repeat; ForEach, Together, Collect, Aggregate, Wait, Ask deferred."
    tracking_bead: vb-xi2f.31

  - id: digest_no_dead_code_regression
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_compile/src/compile/mod.rs
    description: "compile/mod.rs is dead code (no module declaration in lib.rs). If reconnected, both duplicate implementations must stay synchronized per TBL-004."
    tracking_bead: vb-xi2f.31

  # ============================================================
  # SHARD OWNERSHIP
  # ============================================================
  - id: single_shard_owner
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/mod.rs
    description: "Each run has exactly one shard owner at any given time"

  - id: shard_no_global_run_map
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/mod.rs
    description: "No global mutable run map across shards"

# ============================================================
# SCAN COMMANDS PER INVARIANT
# ============================================================
scan_commands:
  no_runtime_yaml:
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --crate vb_core --pattern yaml
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --crate vb_runtime --pattern yaml
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --crate vb_storage --pattern yaml
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --crate vb_ipc --pattern yaml

  no_runtime_json:
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --crate vb_core --pattern serde_json
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --crate vb_runtime --pattern serde_json
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --crate vb_storage --pattern serde_json

  no_hot_path_formatting:
    - cargo xtask hotpath-scan --crate vb_core --pattern format
    - cargo xtask hotpath-scan --crate vb_runtime --pattern format

  no_unchecked_indexing:
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --pattern get_unchecked --crate vb_core
    - cargo xtask forbidden-scan --pattern slice::from_raw_parts

  no_unsafe_in_first_party:
    - cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D unsafe_code

# Layer 1 of the 3-layer cache: sccache wraps rustc and caches compiler
# artifacts in-memory. Hits are shared across every Rust project on this box.
# Sized for 32-core / 126 GB host; 12 GB headroom plus 16 parallel rustc
# jobs gives cache hits on the same crate for both feature and non-feature
# builds. Layer 2 (bazel-remote AC+CAS) and Layer 3 (Cargo `target/`) are
# configured elsewhere; sccache only governs rustc invocations.
[build]
rustc-wrapper = "/home/lewis/.local/share/mise/installs/sccache/0.16.0/sccache-v0.16.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/sccache"
jobs = 16

[env]
SCCACHE_DIR = "/home/lewis/.cache/sccache"
SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE = "12G"
SCCACHE_MAX_FRAME_LENGTH = "104857600"
SCCACHE_BASEDIR = "/home/lewis/src/velvet-ballistics"

[alias]
ci = "clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings"
check-all = "check --workspace --all-targets --all-features"
fmt-check = "fmt --all -- --check"
doc-all = "doc --workspace --all-features --no-deps"
test-all = "test --workspace --all-features"
hardened-build = "build --workspace --all-features --profile hardened"

xtask = "run -p xtask --"

# Mechanical Invariants for velvet-ballistics
# Executable rules checked by `cargo xtask invariants`
# Source of truth for what "mechanically enforced" means

invariants:

  # ============================================================
  # RUNTIME CORE: NO YAML/JSON/HTTP
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_runtime_yaml
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - saphyr_parser
      - parse_workflow_source
      - yaml
      - YamlLoader
      - YamlParser
    description: "Runtime core must not contain YAML parsing or interpretation"

  - id: no_runtime_json
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - serde_json
      - json
      - JsonValue
      - JsonObject
    description: "Runtime core must not contain JSON handling"

  - id: no_runtime_http
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - http
      - hyper
      - reqwest
      - axum
      - actix
    description: "Runtime core must not contain HTTP servers or clients"

  # ============================================================
  # HOT PATH: NO ALLOCATION / FORMATTING
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_hot_path_formatting
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden_macros:
      - format
      - format!
      - println
      - eprintln
      - dbg
      - dbg!
    description: "Hot path must not contain formatting or debug output"

  - id: no_hot_path_allocation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - Vec::new\(\)
      - String::new\(\)
      - Box::new
      - vec!\[\]
    description: "Hot path must not dynamically allocate"
    exceptions:
      - frame_pool initialization (pre-allocated)
      - trace ring initialization (pre-allocated)

  # ============================================================
  # INDEX SAFETY: NO UNCHECKED ARITHMETIC
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unchecked_indexing
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - indexing
      - slicing
      - get_unchecked
      - slice::from_raw_parts
    description: "No unchecked indexing or slicing"

  - id: no_unchecked_arithmetic
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - offset
      - add
      - sub
      - mul
      - wrapping
      - overflowing
    description: "No unchecked arithmetic operations"
    exceptions:
      - checked arithmetic via TryFrom/TryInto
      - saturating arithmetic where explicitly documented

  - id: no_unchecked_casts
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - as_i32
      - as_u64
      - as_usize
      - as_f64
    description: "No unchecked as casts"
    exceptions:
      - checked casts via TryFrom/TryInto
      - checked casts via From/TryFrom traits

  # ============================================================
  # ERROR HANDLING: NO IGNORED RESULTS
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_ignored_result
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - ok\(\)
      - err\(\)
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(
    description: "No ignored Result or Option"

  - id: no_unwrap_in_hot_path
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(

  # ============================================================
  # STATE MACHINE: VALID TRANSITIONS ONLY
  # ============================================================
  - id: step_state_valid_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Valid StepState transitions:
      Pending → Running, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped
      Running → Succeeded, Failed, Waiting, Asking, Cancelled, Skipped
      Waiting → Running
      Asking → Running
      Succeeded/Failed/Cancelled/Skipped → themselves only

  - id: terminal_state_immutable
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Once a run reaches terminal state (Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped),
      it cannot transition back to Running or any non-terminal state

  # ============================================================
  # TAINT: LATTICE LAWS
  # ============================================================
  - id: taint_lattice_join_associative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(join_taint(a, b), c) == join_taint(a, join_taint(b, c))"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_commutative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, b) == join_taint(b, a)"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_idempotent
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, a) == a"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_identity
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, Clean) == a"

  - id: secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, Secret) == Secret"

  - id: derived_from_secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, DerivedFromSecret) == DerivedFromSecret"

  # ============================================================
  # BUDGET: NEVER NEGATIVE / UNDERFLOW
  # ============================================================
  - id: budget_try_take_never_underflows
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::try_take() returns false when budget is 0, never underflows"

  - id: budget_remaining_non_negative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::remaining is always >= 0"

  - id: budget_zero_executes_zero_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "Budget 0 causes immediate StepBudgetExhausted"

  # ============================================================
  # HANDLE VALIDITY
  # ============================================================
  - id: handle_validity_checked
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: |
      All handle accesses (SymbolId, ListId, ObjectId, BlobId) go through
      validity checks. Handle is valid iff id.as_usize() < arena.len()

  # ============================================================
  # RESOURCE BOUNDS
  # ============================================================
  - id: slot_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame slot count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: step_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame step count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: expression_stack_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/stack.rs
    description: "Expression stack depth is bounded to MAX_EXPR_STACK (64)"

  - id: expression_ops_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/bytecode.rs
    description: "Expression op count is bounded to MAX_EXPR_OPS (256)"

  # ============================================================
  # IPC: REJECT BEFORE ALLOCATION
  # ============================================================
  - id: ipc_reject_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      IPC decoder validates magic, header_len, and payload_len <= max
      BEFORE allocating payload bytes

  - id: ipc_no_payload_alloc_on_error
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: "Failed header validation must not allocate payload buffer"

  # ============================================================
  # STORAGE: RECORD DECODE ORDER
  # ============================================================
  - id: record_magic_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates magic before payload allocation"

  - id: record_crc_before_trust
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates CRC before trusting Postcard decode"

  # ============================================================
  # JOURNAL: BEFORE-DISPATCH
  # ============================================================
  - id: journal_before_dispatch
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/journal.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionScheduled journal event committed before action dispatched"

  - id: action_completion_before_frame_mutation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionCompleted journal event committed before frame mutated"

  # ============================================================
  # NO UNSAFE IN FIRST PARTY
  # ============================================================
…
# ============================================================

# Bead vb-08daa: Missing Hunk Recovery from Historical Own Patch

## Contract

This bead recovers 3 missing hunks from historical own-patch `.beads/vb-08daa/historical-own-patch.patch` that were never committed to the velvet-ballistics repo. The 4th hunk (`&source.inputs()` → `source.inputs()`) is already present in `crates/vb_compile/src/mod_compile_lowering/part_01.rs` and requires no change.

## Missing Hunks to Recover

### Hunk 1: .cargo/config.toml (ci alias)
**Current:**
```toml
ci = "clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings"
```
**Target:**
```toml
ci = "clippy --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features -- -D warnings"
```
**Reason:** Test clippy is not strict per AGENTS.md. Use source-only targets for `cargo ci` while keeping `--all-features` for feature-gated code and `-- -D warnings` for warning-as-error.

### Hunk 2: contracts/invariants.yaml (no_unsafe_in_first_party scan)
**Current:**
```yaml
no_unsafe_in_first_party:
    - cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D unsafe_code
```
**Target:**
```yaml
no_unsafe_in_first_party:
    - cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins --examples -- -D unsafe_code
```
**Reason:** Source-only targets for unsafe code scan. Tests may legitimately use unsafe for testing infrastructure.

### Hunk 3: xtask/src/evidence/persistence.rs (clippy repair hint)
**Current:**
```rust
"clippy" => "cargo +nightly clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features",
```
**Target:**
```rust
"clippy" => "cargo +nightly clippy --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features",
```
**Reason:** Consistent repair command with ci alias target selection.

## Already-Present Hunk (No Change Required)

### Hunk 4: crates/vb_compile/src/mod_compile_lowering/part_01.rs
```rust
// Current and target are identical:
allocate_input_slots(source.inputs(), &mut builder).map_err(|e| CompileErrors(vec![e]))?;
```
**Evidence:** Line 59 of part_01.rs shows `source.inputs()` with no `&` — this hunk was already applied.

## Invariants (No Weakening)

- `--workspace` preserved in all three changes
- `--all-features` preserved in ci alias and persistence repair command
- `-- -D warnings` preserved in ci alias
- `check-all` alias unchanged (still uses `--all-targets` for type checking)
- No changes to Rust source code, only config/contract/repair-hint
- `no_unsafe_in_first_party` still denies all unsafe code; only target selection changes

## Existing Verification Gates (No New Tests)

- `moon ci` / `moon run :ci` uses updated `cargo ci` alias
- `cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features -- -D warnings` — manual smoke
- `cargo xtask invariants` — scans contracts/invariants.yaml
- `cargo build --workspace --all-features --profile hardened` — hardened build still uses full targets
- Source lint (`lint-src` moon task) runs with same `cargo ci` config

## Risk Profile

Low. These are tooling/config changes only — no runtime behavior, no API surface, no source attributes. The changes make clippy checks run on source targets instead of all targets (including tests), which aligns with the existing AGENTS.md policy that test clippy is not strict.

# Mechanical Invariants for velvet-ballistics
# Executable rules checked by `cargo xtask invariants`
# Source of truth for what "mechanically enforced" means

invariants:

  # ============================================================
  # RUNTIME CORE: NO YAML/JSON/HTTP
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_runtime_yaml
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - saphyr_parser
      - parse_workflow_source
      - yaml
      - YamlLoader
      - YamlParser
    description: "Runtime core must not contain YAML parsing or interpretation"

  - id: no_runtime_json
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - serde_json
      - json
      - JsonValue
      - JsonObject
    description: "Runtime core must not contain JSON handling"

  - id: no_runtime_http
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - http
      - hyper
      - reqwest
      - axum
      - actix
    description: "Runtime core must not contain HTTP servers or clients"

  # ============================================================
  # HOT PATH: NO ALLOCATION / FORMATTING
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_hot_path_formatting
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden_macros:
      - format
      - format!
      - println
      - eprintln
      - dbg
      - dbg!
    description: "Hot path must not contain formatting or debug output"

  - id: no_hot_path_allocation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - Vec::new\(\)
      - String::new\(\)
      - Box::new
      - vec!\[\]
    description: "Hot path must not dynamically allocate"
    exceptions:
      - frame_pool initialization (pre-allocated)
      - trace ring initialization (pre-allocated)

  # ============================================================
  # INDEX SAFETY: NO UNCHECKED ARITHMETIC
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unchecked_indexing
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - indexing
      - slicing
      - get_unchecked
      - slice::from_raw_parts
    description: "No unchecked indexing or slicing"

  - id: no_unchecked_arithmetic
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - offset
      - add
      - sub
      - mul
      - wrapping
      - overflowing
    description: "No unchecked arithmetic operations"
    exceptions:
      - checked arithmetic via TryFrom/TryInto
      - saturating arithmetic where explicitly documented

  - id: no_unchecked_casts
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - as_i32
      - as_u64
      - as_usize
      - as_f64
    description: "No unchecked as casts"
    exceptions:
      - checked casts via TryFrom/TryInto
      - checked casts via From/TryFrom traits

  # ============================================================
  # ERROR HANDLING: NO IGNORED RESULTS
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_ignored_result
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - ok\(\)
      - err\(\)
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(
    description: "No ignored Result or Option"

  - id: no_unwrap_in_hot_path
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(

  # ============================================================
  # STATE MACHINE: VALID TRANSITIONS ONLY
  # ============================================================
  - id: step_state_valid_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Valid StepState transitions:
      Pending → Running, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped
      Running → Succeeded, Failed, Waiting, Asking, Cancelled, Skipped
      Waiting → Running
      Asking → Running
      Succeeded/Failed/Cancelled/Skipped → themselves only

  - id: terminal_state_immutable
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Once a run reaches terminal state (Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped),
      it cannot transition back to Running or any non-terminal state

  # ============================================================
  # TAINT: LATTICE LAWS
  # ============================================================
  - id: taint_lattice_join_associative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(join_taint(a, b), c) == join_taint(a, join_taint(b, c))"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_commutative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, b) == join_taint(b, a)"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_idempotent
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, a) == a"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_identity
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, Clean) == a"

  - id: secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, Secret) == Secret"

  - id: derived_from_secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, DerivedFromSecret) == DerivedFromSecret"

  # ============================================================
  # BUDGET: NEVER NEGATIVE / UNDERFLOW
  # ============================================================
  - id: budget_try_take_never_underflows
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::try_take() returns false when budget is 0, never underflows"

  - id: budget_remaining_non_negative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::remaining is always >= 0"

  - id: budget_zero_executes_zero_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "Budget 0 causes immediate StepBudgetExhausted"

  # ============================================================
  # HANDLE VALIDITY
  # ============================================================
  - id: handle_validity_checked
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: |
      All handle accesses (SymbolId, ListId, ObjectId, BlobId) go through
      validity checks. Handle is valid iff id.as_usize() < arena.len()

  # ============================================================
  # RESOURCE BOUNDS
  # ============================================================
  - id: slot_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame slot count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: step_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame step count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: expression_stack_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/stack.rs
    description: "Expression stack depth is bounded to MAX_EXPR_STACK (64)"

  - id: expression_ops_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/bytecode.rs
    description: "Expression op count is bounded to MAX_EXPR_OPS (256)"

  # ============================================================
  # IPC: REJECT BEFORE ALLOCATION
  # ============================================================
  - id: ipc_reject_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      IPC decoder validates magic, header_len, and payload_len <= max
      BEFORE allocating payload bytes

  - id: ipc_no_payload_alloc_on_error
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: "Failed header validation must not allocate payload buffer"

  # ============================================================
  # STORAGE: RECORD DECODE ORDER
  # ============================================================
  - id: record_magic_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates magic before payload allocation"

  - id: record_crc_before_trust
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates CRC before trusting Postcard decode"

  # ============================================================
  # JOURNAL: BEFORE-DISPATCH
  # ============================================================
  - id: journal_before_dispatch
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/journal.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionScheduled journal event committed before action dispatched"

  - id: action_completion_before_frame_mutation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionCompleted journal event committed before frame mutated"

  # ============================================================
  # NO UNSAFE IN FIRST PARTY
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unsafe_in_first_party
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_expr/**
      - crates/vb_validate/**
      - crates/vb_compile/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
    description: "First-party crates must have #![forbid(unsafe_code)]"

  # ============================================================
  # NO PANIC IN FIRST PARTY
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_panic_in_first_party
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_expr/**
      - crates/vb_validate/**
      - crates/vb_compile/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
    forbidden:
      - panic!
      - todo!
      - unimplemented!
    description: "First-party code must not panic"
    exceptions:
      - OOM (std::alloc::AllocError) where explicitly noted
      - Catastrophic allocator failure (explicitly documented)

  # ============================================================
  # IDEMPOTENCY
  # ============================================================
  - id: idempotency_key_well_formed
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/idempotency.rs
    description: "Idempotency keys are unique per (run, step, action, attempt)"

  - id: no_duplicate_non_idempotent_effect
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/idempotency.rs
    description: "Non-idempotent actions are not re-executed during replay"

  # ============================================================

  # ============================================================
  - id: digest_primitive_coverage
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_compile/src/mod_compile_lowering/part_05.rs

      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - saphyr_parser
      - parse_workflow_source
      - yaml
      - YamlLoader
      - YamlParser
    description: "Runtime core must not contain YAML parsing or interpretation"

  - id: no_runtime_json
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - serde_json
      - json
      - JsonValue
      - JsonObject
    description: "Runtime core must not contain JSON handling"

  - id: no_runtime_http
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden:
      - http
      - hyper
      - reqwest
      - axum
      - actix
    description: "Runtime core must not contain HTTP servers or clients"

  # ============================================================
  # HOT PATH: NO ALLOCATION / FORMATTING
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_hot_path_formatting
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
      - generated/**
    forbidden_macros:
      - format
      - format!
      - println
      - eprintln
      - dbg
      - dbg!
    description: "Hot path must not contain formatting or debug output"

  - id: no_hot_path_allocation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - Vec::new\(\)
      - String::new\(\)
      - Box::new
      - vec!\[\]
    description: "Hot path must not dynamically allocate"
    exceptions:
      - frame_pool initialization (pre-allocated)
      - trace ring initialization (pre-allocated)

  # ============================================================
  # INDEX SAFETY: NO UNCHECKED ARITHMETIC
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unchecked_indexing
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - indexing
      - slicing
      - get_unchecked
      - slice::from_raw_parts
    description: "No unchecked indexing or slicing"

  - id: no_unchecked_arithmetic
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - offset
      - add
      - sub
      - mul
      - wrapping
      - overflowing
    description: "No unchecked arithmetic operations"
    exceptions:
      - checked arithmetic via TryFrom/TryInto
      - saturating arithmetic where explicitly documented

  - id: no_unchecked_casts
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - as_i32
      - as_u64
      - as_usize
      - as_f64
    description: "No unchecked as casts"
    exceptions:
      - checked casts via TryFrom/TryInto
      - checked casts via From/TryFrom traits

  # ============================================================
  # ERROR HANDLING: NO IGNORED RESULTS
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_ignored_result
    applies_to:
      - crates/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - ok\(\)
      - err\(\)
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(
    description: "No ignored Result or Option"

  - id: no_unwrap_in_hot_path
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/**
    forbidden_patterns:
      - unwrap\(\)
      - expect\(

  # ============================================================
  # STATE MACHINE: VALID TRANSITIONS ONLY
  # ============================================================
  - id: step_state_valid_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Valid StepState transitions:
      Pending → Running, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped
      Running → Succeeded, Failed, Waiting, Asking, Cancelled, Skipped
      Waiting → Running
      Asking → Running
      Succeeded/Failed/Cancelled/Skipped → themselves only

  - id: terminal_state_immutable
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      Once a run reaches terminal state (Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled, Skipped),
      it cannot transition back to Running or any non-terminal state

  # ============================================================
  # TAINT: LATTICE LAWS
  # ============================================================
  - id: taint_lattice_join_associative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(join_taint(a, b), c) == join_taint(a, join_taint(b, c))"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_commutative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, b) == join_taint(b, a)"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_idempotent
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, a) == a"

  - id: taint_lattice_join_identity
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(a, Clean) == a"

  - id: secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, Secret) == Secret"

  - id: derived_from_secret_never_downgrades
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: "join_taint(Clean, DerivedFromSecret) == DerivedFromSecret"

  # ============================================================
  # BUDGET: NEVER NEGATIVE / UNDERFLOW
  # ============================================================
  - id: budget_try_take_never_underflows
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::try_take() returns false when budget is 0, never underflows"

  - id: budget_remaining_non_negative
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "StepBudget::remaining is always >= 0"

  - id: budget_zero_executes_zero_transitions
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/engine.rs
    description: "Budget 0 causes immediate StepBudgetExhausted"

  # ============================================================
  # HANDLE VALIDITY
  # ============================================================
  - id: handle_validity_checked
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/value.rs
    description: |
      All handle accesses (SymbolId, ListId, ObjectId, BlobId) go through
      validity checks. Handle is valid iff id.as_usize() < arena.len()

  # ============================================================
  # RESOURCE BOUNDS
  # ============================================================
  - id: slot_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame slot count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: step_count_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/src/frame.rs
    description: "RunFrame step count is bounded at construction time"

  - id: expression_stack_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/stack.rs
    description: "Expression stack depth is bounded to MAX_EXPR_STACK (64)"

  - id: expression_ops_bounded
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_expr/src/bytecode.rs
    description: "Expression op count is bounded to MAX_EXPR_OPS (256)"

  # ============================================================
  # IPC: REJECT BEFORE ALLOCATION
  # ============================================================
  - id: ipc_reject_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: |
      IPC decoder validates magic, header_len, and payload_len <= max
      BEFORE allocating payload bytes

  - id: ipc_no_payload_alloc_on_error
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_ipc/src/frame.rs
    description: "Failed header validation must not allocate payload buffer"

  # ============================================================
  # STORAGE: RECORD DECODE ORDER
  # ============================================================
  - id: record_magic_before_alloc
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates magic before payload allocation"

  - id: record_crc_before_trust
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_storage/src/record.rs
    description: "Record decoder validates CRC before trusting Postcard decode"

  # ============================================================
  # JOURNAL: BEFORE-DISPATCH
  # ============================================================
  - id: journal_before_dispatch
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/journal.rs
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionScheduled journal event committed before action dispatched"

  - id: action_completion_before_frame_mutation
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/engine/action.rs
    description: "ActionCompleted journal event committed before frame mutated"

  # ============================================================
  # NO UNSAFE IN FIRST PARTY
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_unsafe_in_first_party
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_expr/**
      - crates/vb_validate/**
      - crates/vb_compile/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
    description: "First-party crates must have #![forbid(unsafe_code)]"

  # ============================================================
  # NO PANIC IN FIRST PARTY
  # ============================================================
  - id: no_panic_in_first_party
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_core/**
      - crates/vb_expr/**
      - crates/vb_validate/**
      - crates/vb_compile/**
      - crates/vb_storage/**
      - crates/vb_runtime/**
      - crates/vb_ipc/**
    forbidden:
      - panic!
      - todo!
      - unimplemented!
    description: "First-party code must not panic"
    exceptions:
      - OOM (std::alloc::AllocError) where explicitly noted
      - Catastrophic allocator failure (explicitly documented)

  # ============================================================
  # IDEMPOTENCY
  # ============================================================
  - id: idempotency_key_well_formed
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/idempotency.rs
    description: "Idempotency keys are unique per (run, step, action, attempt)"

  - id: no_duplicate_non_idempotent_effect
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/idempotency.rs
    description: "Non-idempotent actions are not re-executed during replay"

  # ============================================================
  # ============================================================
  # COMPILE DIGEST COMPLETENESS
  # ============================================================
  - id: digest_primitive_coverage
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_compile/src/mod_compile_lowering/part_05.rs
    description: "digest_step_primitive must consume all semantic fields of each StepPrimitive variant (not just the variant name). Currently fixed for Repeat; ForEach, Together, Collect, Aggregate, Wait, Ask deferred."
    tracking_bead: vb-xi2f.31

  - id: digest_no_dead_code_regression
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_compile/src/compile/mod.rs
    description: "compile/mod.rs is dead code (no module declaration in lib.rs). If reconnected, both duplicate implementations must stay synchronized per TBL-004."
    tracking_bead: vb-xi2f.31

  # ============================================================
  # SHARD OWNERSHIP
  # ============================================================
  - id: single_shard_owner
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/mod.rs
    description: "Each run has exactly one shard owner at any given time"

  - id: shard_no_global_run_map
    applies_to:
      - crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/mod.rs
    description: "No global mutable run map across shards"

# Bead vb-08daa: Missing Hunk Recovery — Implementation Record

## Work Performed

Recovered 3 of 4 hunks from `.beads/vb-08daa/historical-own-patch.patch`. The 4th hunk was already present.

### Changes Applied

| File | Line(s) | Change | Historical Hunk |
|------|---------|--------|-----------------|
| `.cargo/config.toml` | 18 | `--all-targets` → `--lib --bins --examples` in `ci` alias | Hunk 1 |
| `contracts/invariants.yaml` | 400 | `--all-targets` → `--lib --bins --examples` in `no_unsafe_in_first_party` scan | Hunk 2 |
| `xtask/src/evidence/persistence.rs` | 67 | `--all-targets --all-features` → `--lib --bins --examples --all-features` in clippy repair hint | Hunk 3 |
| `crates/vb_compile/src/mod_compile_lowering/part_01.rs` | 57 | No change needed — already `source.inputs()` (no `&`) | Hunk 4 (already present) |

### Rationale

- **Hunk 1**: AGENTS.md states "tests compile and run, but test clippy is not strict." The `ci` alias should target source code only (`--lib --bins --examples`), not test code (`--all-targets`).
- **Hunk 2**: Same rationale for the unsafe-code scan. Tests may legitimately use `unsafe` for testing infrastructure (FFI, raw pointer manipulation in test helpers).
- **Hunk 3**: Repair hint must match the `ci` alias target selection for consistency.
- **Hunk 4**: Already present in current code — `source.inputs()` returns `&[InputField]` directly; the `&` was historical cruft removed by an earlier pass.

### Preserved Invariants

- `--workspace` flag preserved in all 3 changed commands
- `--all-features` preserved in `ci` alias and persistence repair command
- `-- -D warnings` preserved in `ci` alias
- `check-all` alias unchanged (type checking still uses `--all-targets`)
- No Rust source modifications
- No test framework changes
- No new tests or test scripts created
- Master doc and broader docs unchanged per user instruction

### Verification Method

No tests executed. This is config/contract/repair-hint recovery with no runtime behavior change. Verification relies on:
- `moon ci` / `moon run :ci` using updated `cargo ci` alias
- `cargo xtask invariants` scanning updated `contracts/invariants.yaml`
- Manual `cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features -- -D warnings` as smoke
- Existing source lint policy in master and `.moon` tasks unaffected

### Risk Profile

Low. Tooling-only changes. No API, source attribute, or runtime behavior modifications.
